info.title: Application Visibility
info.description: API to retrieve VSX (Virtual Switching Extension) information for switches.

tags.name: Application Visibility
tags.description: Application Visibility APIs provide details about applications accessed in a site or by a client.

get.description: This API endpoint returns the top N application categories ranked by usage (tx + rx bytes) for the requested scope. The maximum time range is 7 days. If the range between start-at and end-at exceeds 7 days, start-at is automatically adjusted to be 7 days before end-at. This is intentional behavior; no error is returned.
get.summary: Get top application categories by usage

parameters.name: start-at
parameters.description: The start time in RFC 3339 Format or epoch milliseconds (must be within 7 days of end-at).

parameters.name: end-at
parameters.description: The end time in RFC 3339 Format or epoch milliseconds (must be greater than start-at).

parameters.name: site-id
parameters.description: Filter by site identifier.

parameters.name: client-id
parameters.description: Filter by client MAC address. Forces use of the main data table (not aggregated).

parameters.name: serial-number
parameters.description: Filter by device serial number. Forces use of the main data table (not aggregated).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (1–500). Default: 100.

parameters.name: ssid
parameters.description: Filter by SSID name.

parameters.name: user-role
parameters.description: Filter by user role.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the first item to return. Default: 0.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Maximum number of top-ranked application categories to return in total across all pages (1–500). Default: 100.

get.description: This API endpoint retrieves applications accessed in a site by all clients or by a specific client.
get.summary: Get applications accessed in a site

parameters.name: site-id
parameters.description: The ID of the site from which applications will be retrieved.

parameters.name: client-id
parameters.description: The client MAC of the source device.

parameters.name: start-at
parameters.description: The start time in RFC 3339 Format (must be within 7 days of end-at).

parameters.name: end-at
parameters.description: The end time in RFC 3339 Format (must be greater than start-at)

schema.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of results. Use the value returned in the `next` response field to retrieve the next page. Providing both `next` and `offset` in the same request returns `400 Bad Request`.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The offset of the item at which to begin the response. Providing both `offset` and `next` in the same request returns `400 Bad Request`.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
OData Version 4.0 filter string (limited functionality). Supports only 'and', 'eq', and 'in' conjunction ('or' and 'not' are NOT supported). Supported fields and operators are in the table below. Multiple filters are supported.
| Field   | Operators | Required | Type    | Default Value | Summary                                                           |
|---------|-----------|----------|---------|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `field` | `eq`      | No       | String  | N/A            | Format is a string from a specified enum list given below         |
| `terms` | `in`      | No       | String  | N/A            | Format is a list of strings                                       |

**The operators are implemented as follows:**

* `eq`: Only values exactly matching the given value are returned.
* `in`: Only values present in the given list are returned.

**List of applicable filters for field and terms**

| Field                    | Applicable Terms                                                                  | Summary                                                |
|--------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| APP_CAT                  | Refer to list below. Example: ["Antivirus", "Web"]                                | Returns applications based on application categories   |
| STATE                    | ["allowed", "partial", "blocked"]                                                | Returns applications by assigned permissions           |
| RISK                     | ["Low", "High", "Suspicious", "Moderate", "Trustworthy", "Not Evaluated"]         | Returns applications based on risk level               |
| TLS_VERSION              | ["TLS 1.1", "TLS 1.2"] (examples)                                                 | Returns applications by TLS version                    |
| APPLICATION_HOST_TYPE    | ["Hybrid", "Private", "Public"]                                                    | Returns applications by host type                      |
| COUNTRY                  | Depends on app server location (use country code, e.g., "IN")                      | Returns applications by server location                |
| ROLE                     | Depends on roles assigned to the user                                              | Returns applications by assigned roles                 |

List of application categories available:
* Antivirus
* Business and Economy
* Computer and Internet Info
* Computer and Internet Security
* Encrypted
* Internet Communications
* Network Service
* Office365 SAAS
* Standard
* Web

If no filter is passed as the query param, default behavior returns both active and inactive applications.
parameters.example: ('field' eq 'INCLUDE_INACTIVE_APP' and 'terms' in ('True')) and ('field' eq 'LIST_VIEW_TAB' and 'terms' in ('APPLICATIONS'))

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field followed by direction indicator (asc/desc). Supported fields: NAME, CATEGORY, EXPERIENCE, RISK, USAGE, STATE, LASTUSEDTIME, TLSVERSION, CERTIFICATEEXPIRYDATE, APPLICATIONHOSTTYPE, COUNTRY.
